title: Esperanza Tras la Lluvia: Ilustración Puzzle en Cuadrícula 3x3 de Múltiples Estilos
prompt:
A 3x3 grid illustration puzzle. The overall atmosphere is warm, healing, inspiring, and comfortable. A unified warm color palette coordinates the entire grid. 

Theme: The first rainbow appearing over Milford Sound, New Zealand after a gentle rain.

Row 1: Gentle & Magical
1-1 (Puuung Style): A couple sitting on a wooden dock at Milford Sound, sharing a hot drink under the rainbow, warm golden light.
1-2 (Soosh Style): A giant, gentle misty mountain spirit protecting a tiny hiker from the lingering drizzle, watercolor texture.
1-3 (Taryn Knight Style): Glowworms in a nearby cave illuminating the scene with soft bioluminescence, whimsical nature.

Row 2: Philosophy & Center
2-1 (Mari Andrew Style): A simple hand-drawn chart showing "Rain + Sun = Rainbow", exploring the necessity of hardships for beauty.
2-2 (Center Title): A hand-drawn round badge with the text "Hope After Rain" in a beautiful font, surrounded by fern motifs.
2-3 (Ming Mirin Style): A bright, pastel scene of a kiwi bird looking up at the rainbow happily.

Row 3: Healing & Company
3-1 (Big Orange Style): A very round, chubby sheep looking incredibly fluffy and satisfied under the rainbow.
3-2 (Kubomono Style): A tiny human leaning against a giant, realistic but soft Kea parrot, finding peace in the landscape.
3-3 (Charlene Chua Style): Anthropomorphic native birds (Tui, Fantail) celebrating the sunshine and rainbow in a storybook style. --ar 1:1
